title: verify: digest mismatch uses SmimeError::Other, not SignatureVerification
description: verify.rs check_message_digest line 304: when the computed content hash does not match the messageDigest attribute, returns Err(SmimeError::Other('message digest mismatch')). SmimeError::SignatureVerification already exists and is the correct variant for a failed cryptographic check. Using Other here means callers matching on SmimeError::SignatureVerification will miss this failure mode. The caller in verify_one reports this as a per-signer error string, so the impact is limited to programmatic matching on the top-level SmimeError — but it is still incorrect classification.
